project_type: Python modular reconnaissance platform with asyncio-based orchestration
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, ruff for linting. Tests in tests/atomic/
verification_instructions: 1) pip install -e '.[dev]'  2) pytest -q  3) ruff check recontool/ tests/
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. Python 3.11.15 via pyenv. No Docker daemon available for runtime tests but Dockerfile can be validated syntactically.
contribution_requirements: Keep adapters pure (no cross-asset logic). Normalization engine is sole DB writer. Preserve backwards compat with existing pipeline. Use typed models and schemas.
key_patterns: Adapters self-register via @register decorator. Generic adapters built from YAML specs. Events are normalized into DB via Normalizer. FrontierManager handles work queue with dedup. AdapterContext carries shared state. RateProfile controls concurrency. Config uses ENV > YAML > default precedence.
directory_structure: recontool/ (main package): adapters/ (tool integrations), ai/ (supervisor), core/ (models, db, dedupe, scope), net/ (http, proxy, rate-limit), normalize/ (DB writer), orchestrator/ (pipeline+frontier), inventory/ (doc generators). config/ (YAML tool registry + settings). tests/atomic/ (unit tests). docs/ (architecture docs + 532 tool docs).
